baseline_mismatch.red_scope: Initial four test declarations preceded helper formatting and later trace/contracts expansion; historical regression evidence only.

behavior: A single gate validates index0, used0/1, matching initialized first prefix, positive physical capacity, nonzero-sized T, and empty registered later blocks. Missing/freed storage and later sparse requests reject before any constructor or assignment callback.

New first-slot emplacement reuses the append construction engine, avoiding sparse staging and stride division. Construction failure leaves used0 and the retained physical allocation unchanged. Success records length1, publishes used1 and preserves the conservative tail-scan flag.

Existing assignable replacement keeps native temporary construction, assignment, temporary destruction and old used1 through failures. Constructor failure preserves the old target; assignment failure keeps target mutations. Borrowed and moved SetValue callbacks preserve their distinct constructor phases and observable moved donor state.

Internal SetValue uses the established native element-coordinate helper instead of dividing by a zero stride. Self-copy creates a separate temporary; self-move mutates the source before assignment, and a throwing move leaves the live original target mutated without temporary destruction.

IndexMut0 only returns the already registered live first slot, without Default construction. The uninitialized first slot remains rejected. A payload with panicking Default and no Clone proves this bound and callback distinction.

Cached capture records current=actual block0 and block_end=actual block0+0, retaining native snapshot end1. Both shared and mutable constructors are instantiated natively; mutable provenance comes from raw mutable allocation access. A focused unit verifies the zero cached block extent directly.

Native iterator rows and strict Miri cover advance-to-end, retreat and write, allocation move, original owner reset/refill, saved pointer still reading the moved allocation, and offset0 reloading the original owner while preserving end1. Wrong-owner/dead-slot reload is rejected before cache mutation; no dead-slot dereference is performed.

Twenty-six native UBSan rows match the Rust event trace exactly. All52 original names join native, Rust normal and strict Miri runtime results. Eleven exact declaration IDs bind9 current body-bearing public Rust methods. EmplaceValue template/child rows are both identified without additional semantic credit.
limitations: Only retained first-slot zero-stride state is admitted. Later diagonal zero-stride slots can have defined native storage and remain actionable ownership-model gaps; they are not labeled blanket native undefined behavior.

Explicit callbacks select C++ constructor and move-assignment semantics. Ordinary emplace_value remains a Rust convenience that drops/replaces an existing value; it does not automatically infer C++ assignability or reproduce nontrivial assignment. Its receipt domain is constructor/new-slot and POD replacement behavior.

Nonassignable reconstruction callbacks retain their existing explicit unsafe lifetime/repair obligations. This receipt does not claim new native coverage for their zero-stride failure branches, zero-stride insertion, or arbitrary unpublished raw lifetimes.

Zero-sized T, absent/freed storage, unregistered live bytes, invalid indices, and unsupported sparse prefixes are rejected as checked Rust extensions before callbacks. No native UB equivalence is claimed for invalid reads or writes.

Clear at zero stride still omits destructors as documented by the dependency receipt. Tests erase heap-owning live first-slot payloads before cleanup and never silently repair native exception state before observation. Broader constructor-failure descriptor/resource lifetime parity remains actionable.

Cached navigation requires the supplied original owner identity, never dereferences a stored owner pointer, and unsafe access requires the actual current allocation owner/lifetime. The added capture domain does not remove these contracts or make dangling cached pointers safe to dereference.

The native fixture is UBSan-instrumented and links the pinned prebuilt x86_64 TKernel. Historical receipts remain unchanged; this scoped source/compiler snapshot adds no global API or legacy-test completion credit.
